values.summary: Bind #490 from current main, run only read-only gcloud discovery, normalize a decision register under owned docs/evidence paths, validate redaction and no-mutation posture, obtain fresh review, and publish one closing PR.

steps.action: Bind issue #490 from current main in a FastWork worktree.
Verify current gcloud identity, project, billing, and organization decision inputs with read-only commands.
Write the GCP decision register with ownership, region, cost ceiling, and quota/capacity boundaries.
Validate redaction, no-mutation command posture, diff hygiene, and lifecycle truth.
Obtain fresh exact-head review, fix findings, publish, shepherd green checks, finish, and leave cleanup async.

invariants: No GCP mutation commands are run.
Quota is never claimed as available runtime capacity.
Cost ceiling is explicit before downstream bootstrap.
risks: The active gcloud context could point at the wrong account.
Billing visibility may be insufficient for a final decision.
Readbacks could expose sensitive token fields if command selection widens.
Quota could be mistaken for approved capacity.
stop_conditions: Credit expiry or cost basis is unknown.
Fresh review finds unresolved actionable issues.
